input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding Customer (Section 23 has no operative text, and no other inspection or monitoring rights exist). It meets the preferred position on every material term: one audit per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bearing costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment above five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, and other suppliers' confidential information. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are Customer Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report). No redline needed.
